content.text:
# Yuzustride Halloween campaign recap (Oct 23–31, 2027 ET)

The campaign spent **$677.01** of the $700 budget and produced **659,621 impressions** and **326 link clicks** to yuzustride.com/halloween. That works out to **$2.08 per click**.

**I can't tell you how many free-trial starts these clicks produced.** Your site has no X pixel, so X never sees the trial starts. To get the result you care about, compare your own trial-start data for Oct 23–31 against these 326 clicks.

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost/click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "Your next relay starts on screen…" | $431.34 | 361,000 | 208 | $2.07 |
| "October 31 is the deadline…" | $245.67 | 298,600 | 118 | $2.08 |
| **Total** | **$677.01** | **659,621** | **326** | **$2.08** |

**How it ran:**
- **Setup:** one campaign with one ad group, running both approved posts. It was optimized for link clicks, since X can't track trial starts. It targeted only the United States and Canada on iOS and Android, because that's the only place people can start a trial.
- **Cost per click:** both posts cost almost the same per click, so I kept both running. X gave more of the budget to the "relay" post.
- **Budget changes:** I raised the daily cap twice (Oct 27 and Oct 31) to catch up on pacing. The $700 total cap stayed in place the whole time.
- **Unspent budget:** $22.99 wasn't spent because Halloween delivery came in under the raised cap.

**Status:** the campaign stopped at its scheduled end (midnight ET, Oct 31). Nothing is still spending.

**Next time:** if you install X's pixel and fire it on trial start, X can optimize for actual trial starts instead of clicks, and I can report them directly.
